Use case: illustration-story.
Create one complete original fictional narrative illustration, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 pixels. A premium painterly cinematic fantasy storybook scene in the Deltaris coastal workshop, a richly crafted stone workshop overlooking a sunlit Mediterranean-like fantasy harbor, distant ivory city and a slender central tower with sapphire beacon. Scene: a dwarven craftmaster has been caught rearranging the small wooden obstacles of a tabletop test track so that they exactly accommodate a tiny brass cart. He has a sheepishly thoughtful expression, one hand visibly moving an obstacle away from the cart. Beside him a friendly enormous automaton gently points toward a second untouched tabletop test track whose far end is still partly covered by a simple canvas cloth. The visual joke is that the craftsman is changing the examination to suit the cart rather than improving the research. The track objects are physical handmade workshop miniatures, never a chart, diagram, board-game UI, or labeled test. Keep the action easy to understand, with the moved obstacle, tiny cart and second covered track distinct.
Character continuity: enormous friendly automaton, rounded round head, two luminous circular cyan eyes, heavy dark charcoal-blue armor with antique brass edges and delicate antique-gold filigree; large faceted brilliant sapphire-blue communication crystal set in the middle of its chest; articulated brass and dark-metal fingers. Dwarven master: warm tan skin, broad nose, expressive dark eyebrows, dark hair swept back, thick dark beard braided into several strands with small brass clasps, large brass goggles on his forehead, rolled ivory sleeves, worn brown/navy leather work apron and navy mantle. Preserve their clear size difference, robot twice the master's height. Both kind and earnest, lightly comic, not caricature slapstick.
Visual treatment: premium detailed painterly fantasy storybook realism, physically plausible brass and leather textures, warm amber workshop lanterns against cool maritime blue daylight, restrained gold accents, atmospheric depth, legible composition, characters and tabletop fill foreground while harbor stays secondary. No readable text, no letters, no digits, no captions, no labels, no graphs, no financial chart, no UI, no logo, no watermark. One image only.
assets.visualQA: Moved wooden obstacle and tiny cart clearly visible; robot points to second partly covered track; character continuity and harbor palette inspected; no text or numerical content.
